materials.prompt: Original square seamless PBR ALBEDO game terrain texture. Orthographic overhead view of temperate European ground at meso scale: irregular green grasses, small patches of dark brown earth, scattered dry oak leaf fragments, fine gray pebbles, subtle low moss. Natural intricate but restrained surface detail, cool muted greens and earthy browns. No dense clump borders, no conspicuous cracks, no flowers, no branches or objects, no buildings, no roads, no water, no horizon, no text or panel layout. Flat diffuse illumination with no directional shadows or specular highlights. Seamless on all four edges, no vignette. Suitable for scaled blending in a geographically grounded grand strategy game, independent original asset not copying an existing game texture.

Original square seamless PBR ALBEDO game terrain texture. Mixed gravel pavement and rock, NOT all sand dunes, NOT a paving pattern, no giant canyon geometry. Natural fine and medium scale irregularity, realistic restrained warm mineral color, no greenery or water, no landmarks, no architecture, no roads, no text, no borders. Completely diffuse flat lighting, no baked directional shadows or sunlight. Four edges tile seamlessly, no vignette. Designed as independently authored surface material for North African and Iranian arid terrain, not a copy of a game asset.

Original single square seamless game terrain ALBEDO texture for alluvial river lowlands. Orthographic straight-down close aerial view of earthy gray-brown and muted umber silt with tiny fine pebbles, natural small eroded patches, restrained green grasses and scattered reedlike low plants through damp mineral ground. A cohesive natural soil/grass surface, not lush tropical jungle and not desert cracked polygons. Mix roughly half sparse grassy ground and half soft silt/earth, small patches rather than dominant motifs. No water, no drawn river channel, no farmland boundaries or crops, no roads or buildings, no horizon, no labels or frame. Neutral flat diffuse overcast illumination with no baked shadows/highlights. Tile seamlessly on all four edges. Original independent material to blend near existing mapped rivers in an ancient Mediterranean strategy game, no historical or archaeological reconstruction claim and no copying proprietary assets.
